title: Declaration Base Information Package
description: Business to government submissions: import and export declarations, cargo reports, transit declarations.

nodes.name: Declaration
nodes.definition: Details related to any statement or action, in any form prescribed or accepted by the Government Agency, giving information or particulars required by the Governmental Agency.

nodes.name: Document acceptance date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time of acceptance of a document in accordance with governmental legislation.

nodes.name: Document/message cancellation date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time when the document/message was cancelled.

nodes.name: Document effective date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time of effectiveness of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

nodes.name: Document expiration date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time of expiration of the document (e.g. license, visa, permit, certificate, bond).

nodes.name: Message function code
nodes.definition: Code specifying the function of a document.

nodes.name: Functional identifier
nodes.definition: Identification of a specific information exchange.
nodes.remark: Document reference number, assigned by the Trader

nodes.name: Document identifier
nodes.definition: Identification of a specific document.
nodes.remark: Document reference number, assigned by the Government

nodes.name: Document issuing date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time the document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

nodes.name: Document issuing location identifier
nodes.definition: Identification of the location at which a document was issued and when appropriate, signed or otherwise authenticated.

nodes.name: Language code
nodes.definition: Code specifying the language used or requested.

nodes.name: Document/message rejection date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time when the document/message was rejected.

nodes.name: Document/message status code
nodes.definition: Code specifying the status of a document.

nodes.name: Document name code
nodes.definition: Code specifying the name of a document.
nodes.code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1001 OR User code list

nodes.name: Version identifier
nodes.definition: Identification of the version of a specific document/message number.

nodes.name: Reply type code
nodes.definition: Code specifying the type of reply required or transmitted.
nodes.code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 4343 OR User code list

nodes.name: Requested validity period quantity
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the requested validity expressed in days (i.e., it will be a number of days indicated in the data field and not a period expressed as "from ? until ?").

nodes.name: Total number of items
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of goods items within a document.

nodes.name: Total invoice amount
nodes.definition: Amount indicating the total of all invoice amounts in a single declaration.

nodes.name: Number of loading lists
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the number of loading lists, manifests or similar documents.

nodes.name: Jurisdiction (authority) date/time
nodes.definition: Date and time of landing, bringing, or introduction at any place subject to a country's jurisdiction whether or not such landing, bringing, or introduction constitutes an import (e.g. the date of import used in US tariff laws).

nodes.name: Total number of packages
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

nodes.name: Number of seals
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the number of seals affixed.

nodes.name: Transport movement code
nodes.definition: Code specifying a particular transport movement.

nodes.name: Specific circumstances code
nodes.definition: Code specifying circumstances for declarations.

nodes.name: Number of split-consignments
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of split-consignments for a transit declaration.

nodes.name: Safety and security code
nodes.definition: Code specifying whether the declaration is combined with safety and security related declarations.
nodes.code_list:
User code list
(EU CDM codes available, could be the basis for new WCO codes)

nodes.name: Referral request identifier
nodes.definition:
Identification of the referral request received.
Note for EU CDM users:
This data element shall only be provided where the declaration is amended upon a referral request (Annex B DA).

nodes.name: Consignment
nodes.definition: Details related to the transport between a consignor and a consignee as specified in the transport contract document.

nodes.definition: Code specifying whether the start date of a customs control is confirmed or not.

nodes.definition: Code specifying whether or not goods are transported in a container.

For use with the EU CDM:

nodes.definition: Date and time that goods are expected to arrive in the country of destination.

nodes.definition: Code specifying the status of goods as identified by customs for regulation purposes or as a result of an action by the declarant or government agency.

nodes.name: Sequence number
nodes.definition: Number indicating the position in a sequence.

nodes.definition: Amount declared for customs purposes of those goods in a consignment whether or not they are subject to the same customs procedure, tariff/statistical heading, country information and duty regime.

nodes.name: Total number of packages
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the total number of packages of the entire document (e.g. declaration/consignment).

nodes.name: Boarded quantity
nodes.definition: Quantity specifying the total number shown on bill of lading or on split shipment. It will be the actual number of pieces boarded on the conveyance. (Not necessarily the smallest external packaging unit for the shipment).

nodes.name: Action code
nodes.definition: Code specifying the action to be taken or already taken.
nodes.code_list: UN/EDIFACT code list 1229 OR User code list

nodes.name: Carriage amount
nodes.definition: Amount declared by the shipper or his agent solely for the purpose of varying the carrier's level of liability from that provided in the contract of carriage, in case of loss or damage to goods or delayed delivery.

nodes.name: Receptacle (postal) identifier
nodes.definition: Identification of the postal receptacle.

nodes.name: Split-consignment identifier
nodes.definition: Identification of a split-consignment in a transit declaration.

nodes.name: Consolidation indicator
nodes.definition: Indicator of the cargo shipping method in which a freight forwarder at the place/port of origin combines several individual consignments to make up a full load.

nodes.name: Heavy or bulky goods indicator
nodes.definition: Indicator stating that the goods are of a heavy or bulky nature and therefore cannot be transported in a sealable transport equipment.
